title: Fynkel volume profile
description: `<name>.volume.json` (R3a, `docs/renderer.md` § Volumes): a post-processing profile: the look overrides (ambient occlusion R3a, bloom R3b, colour grading R3c) a `fynkel.Volume` component applies to the frame. Every block and every field is optional: a field that is present overrides what is below it (the engine default, or a lower-priority volume), a field that is absent is inherited. The renderer blends the volumes that reach the camera once per frame, each by its weight × how far inside its shape the camera is. The project's quality profile is the ceiling: a profile can shape an effect the quality profile has on, never turn on one it has off.

ambientOcclusion.description: Screen-space ambient occlusion (R2): how much of the sky each pixel can see, applied to ambient and image-based light only.

radius.description: How far the occlusion reaches, in metres (engine default 0.6).

intensity.description: The exponent the visible fraction is raised to: 0 turns the occlusion off, 1 is linear, larger is darker (engine default 1.35).

bloom.description: Bloom (R3b): light brighter than the threshold spreads into its neighbourhood, blurred over a chain of half-size copies of the frame and added back before tone mapping. Off until a profile gives it an intensity.

intensity.description: How much of the blurred light is added back: 0 is off (engine default 0).

threshold.description: The brightness after exposure (1 = white) above which a pixel starts to glow, with a soft knee of half the threshold (engine default 0.9).

scatter.description: How far the glow spreads: 0 keeps it tight around the source, 1 carries it wide (engine default 0.7).

tint.description: Linear RGB multiplied into the glow, each `0..=1` (engine default [1, 1, 1]).

colorGrading.description: Colour grading (R3c), Unity's Tonemapping, White Balance, Color Adjustments and Lift Gamma Gain in one block. In order: post-exposure and white balance, contrast, colour filter, hue shift and saturation on the scene's radiance; the tone mapper; lift, gamma and gain on the display's 0..1. Every field's engine default is neutral; with only the tone mapper set, nothing else runs.

tonemapper.description: The curve that brings the scene into the display's range: `aces` filmic (engine default), `neutral` (little hue or saturation shift, a gentler shoulder), `none` (clamped at white). A choice does not blend: any part of a volume sets it.

postExposure.description: Stops added to the camera's exposure (engine default 0).

temperature.description: White balance: negative cools (bluer), positive warms (yellower) (engine default 0).

tint.description: White balance: negative toward green, positive toward magenta (engine default 0).

contrast.description: Spreads (positive) or gathers (negative) the tones around middle grey (engine default 0).

saturation.description: -100 is grey, 100 twice as vivid (engine default 0).

hueShift.description: Degrees every hue is turned round the colour wheel (engine default 0).

colorFilter.description: Linear RGB multiplied into the scene, each `0..=1` (engine default [1, 1, 1]).

lift.description: Per channel, `-1..=1`: raises (or lowers) the darks, leaving white where it is (engine default [0, 0, 0]).

gamma.description: Per channel: above 1 brightens the midtones, below 1 darkens them, black and white stay (engine default [1, 1, 1]).

gain.description: Per channel: scales the brights (engine default [1, 1, 1]).
